purpose: Freeze the exact effective execution-code set for the successor Full144 run. The old Full144 freeze recorded only the driver hash; the effective behaviour also depends on the imported qualified runner and the successor route-closure projection.
aggregate_hash_method: SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted lines '<sha256>  <path>', paths sorted lexicographically, one trailing LF.

members.role: Full144 execution driver (additive refreeze: run root overridable via R4_FULL144_RUN_ROOT; default remains the frozen historical root)
Frozen Full144 population/order/binding authority used by the driver
Qualified Attempt-6 runner reused by the driver for ALL behavioural semantics (successor runtime_pins route projection)
Successor D7 install-route closure projection (reuses frozen R3 closure; generic route-authority rule; R4-B parser untouched)

exclusion_rule: Unchanged modules required by the execution path are already frozen by git blobs and covered by the frozen-invariance audit; only modules whose changed behaviour is required by the successor path are members.
